composition: Consumer extensions add assertions to the named original schedule; intent schedules reuse its invariants. Repetition, timing and IDs are engineering test choices, not protocol fields.

preconditions: Run V06 through lost H2 receipt and partial H3 playback; learner later corrects a step.

schedule.action: Read the current evidence set E1, including H2 unknown exposure and H3 partial ranges; start projection J1 and retain a current E1 projection.
Deliver exact H2 or newly confirmed H3 solution-bearing range evidence causally preceding the correction.
Append the fact with a new evidence-set revision and invalidate affected current projections atomically; replay the identical receipt.
Try committing J1 against E1; then rebuild from current evidence after restart.
Repeat with J1 committing before the new fact; separately remove causal links and supply disagreeing device wall clocks.

expected: No old E1 judgment remains current after the fact commits, including when its computation committed first.
An in-flight E1 job fails its evidence-set fence; newly arriving facts not listed in E1 still change the set.
Exact replay adds no new fact or repeated invalidation; unconfirmed ranges stay unknown.
Without causal evidence, exposure-to-correction ordering is unknown, not inferred from wall clocks or final correctness.
Neither reported playback nor reclassification proves attention, understanding or independent mastery.

preconditions: V12's original process and diagnosis correction remain retained; an actually displayed H1 notification was assessed as a hint.

schedule.action: Create classification M1 and cache eligibility from H1 assessment K1; begin an old evidence-bound job.
As in learning p37, identify actual solution disclosure in the preserved H1 bytes and append assessment K2 with evidence/uncertainty.
Advance assessed-evidence head and invalidate dependent diagnosis/classification and future hint-cache eligibility atomically.
Try committing or presenting results using K1 after K2; restart retrieval under another model.
Repeat with the old job committing first, followed by K2 invalidation.

expected: Original request, hint-only permission, content bytes/hash, channel and raw presentation facts remain unchanged.
K2 does not retroactively authorize the solution; the violation remains visible in history.
Dependent M1 is no longer current; old work cannot restore K1 labels or reuse solution content as a hint.
User-reason correction in V12 and assistance-assessment correction have separate provenance; neither invents unseen presentation.
Independent semantic review is required; a hint enum passing validation is insufficient.

preconditions: A2 is a retained retry of Q1; its learning projection cites solution exposure in A1. A2 has independent original ink and steps.

schedule.action: Read A1 exposure and A2 originals into J1; retain a current cross-attempt classification.
Delete A1 including its assistance content/evidence according to the authorized scope.
Tombstone A1 and remove/invalidate dependent derived claims across A2 without deleting A2 originals; fence queued results.
Commit J1, replay A1 receipts and rebuild A2 after restart from surviving records.
Reverse the J1/delete commit order and inspect current and historical derivative content for deleted material.

expected: A2's independent originals remain unchanged; current claims depending on deleted A1 evidence do not.
J1 cannot publish after deletion; a prior J1 commit is removed/invalidated by the deletion transaction.
Deleted receipt absence never establishes an unseen-solution or independent-work claim.
No hidden help text, fingerprint, cached explanation or backup reconstruction is retained to make classification easy.
Only lead-approved minimal non-content deletion/invalidation state may remain; if insufficient, confidence is withdrawn/unknown.
Independent shared sources and pending remote cleanup retain their separately verified state.

preconditions: After help withdrawal, an E1 learning projection still reflects unknown earlier exposure, while the exact historical H1 receipt is delayed.

schedule.action: Begin J1 bound to E1 and expose an E1-derived current assessment.
Deliver H1's authenticated late historical receipt then repeat the same delivery.
Record the past presentation once, advance affected evidence and invalidate E1-dependent judgments in one transaction.
Try committing J1 and using that receipt to replay H1; restart and read current evidence.
Repeat with J1 committing before receipt arrival; separately provide no reliable causal order against the learner correction.

expected: Both commit orders remove stale current judgments; duplicate receipt is idempotent.
Earlier truthful exposure survives help withdrawal and influences current evidence without rewriting raw steps.
Receipt arrival authorizes neither replay nor a new higher-help cache response.
Unknown causal order remains unknown even if receipt arrival is later than the correction.

preconditions: Retain V17's three distinct evidence patterns; add an evidenced Q1 A1-to-A2 retry and a truly unseen Q2 sharing only the concept.

schedule.action: Report Q1 A1 solution display and separately record an actually shown hint whose help extent is initially uncertain.
Start Q1 A2 with no A2-local help receipts and complete work; separately work on Q2 without observed help, retaining coverage and reasoning.
Read question/attempt relations, earlier website/AI exposure and versioned semantic assistance assessments.
Correct the uncertain help extent with evidence; invalidate affected current labels and attempt an old projection commit.
Replace confirmed Q1/Q2 identity with ambiguous reused-title evidence and rerun the classification design.

expected: Q1 A2 does not become unaided merely by receiving a new attempt ID or empty local help list.
Actual extent, allowed extent and generated-only/unknown/partial evidence stay distinct under assessment corrections.
Q2 is a separate independent-transfer candidate only with actual observed reasoning/correctness and adequate evidence; it is not automatically mastered.
Learning the concept previously does not imply solution exposure on every future question.
Ambiguous problem identity or causal evidence prevents confident labels, not a guessed merge or guessed unseen status.
Corrected help evidence invalidates both prior current projections and stale in-flight jobs.

preconditions: Q1 A1 mixes entries and has website solution feedback plus AI assistance with separately evidenced visibility.

schedule.action: Explicitly retry Q1 as A2, move to another input surface and submit historical A1 events after A2 starts.
Evaluate A2 with no A2-local presentation records using the confirmed Q1 relation and earlier exposure.
Reuse a URL/node for a possible Q2; retain an uncertain navigation gap instead of linking by text similarity.
Clarify an ambiguous same-question/new-question relation with recorded evidence; fence classifications computed on the earlier relation.
Compare a separately confirmed unseen Q2 on the same concept with Q1's retry.

expected: Same-question exposure follows evidenced relations across entries/retries while original attempt IDs remain distinct.
Website feedback retains publisher/source/observed visibility and is not reclassified as the learner's reasoning or application AI.
Newly discovered/corrected identity changes the consumer evidence set and invalidates affected old jobs/current labels.
Late A1 events cannot overwrite active Q2 or grant it help permission.
Confirmed unseen Q2 is assessed on its own work; an unknown navigation interval cannot establish unseen status.

preconditions: C1 is the exact stored composite for Q1; user-help records contain no confirmed supplement display.

schedule.action: Record only actual request/transport/provider evidence for sending C1, with its frame/ink/layer bindings and limits.
Try treating that AI-input evidence as a learner presentation receipt.
Separately report exact supplement text display or a played audio range, with any remainder unknown.
Delay either family until Q2 is active and verify the original bindings.

expected: AI input does not populate learner exposure, prove learner understanding or establish independent mastery.
Client-reported help does not establish that the AI received or recognized the original ink.
Each receipt keeps its producer, exact subject/revision and limitations; late receipts retain Q1 history.
No per-artifact provider acknowledgement is invented; no receiver's semantic understanding is inferred from transport evidence.

preconditions: V25's X5 omits removed L2; an independent earlier L2 display receipt may or may not exist.

schedule.action: Observe supported actual import of X5, retaining artifact binding and machine/human provenance.
Try inferring L2 presentation from X5's import, and separately read any genuine earlier L2 presentation.
Use a second export including an AI layer but with no observed learner-facing target display.
Provide only share-started or a human attestation, and then delayed exact target evidence.

expected: X5 import cannot deliver the omitted L2 or create a new learner-help fact for it.
Earlier genuine L2 exposure remains history despite removal from the note/export; removal is not privacy deletion.
Import of an included AI layer without observed target presentation does not establish learner exposure or understanding.
Human attestation stays labeled; share callbacks do not become machine import proof.
Receipt arrival does not change editable originals, current help permission, native-stroke capability or unverified A44 status.

preconditions: On a declared supported path, Q1/frame F1 has both content-attached ink and screen-fixed ink; each is independently retained with source/context.
Include a screen-fixed learning note and content-attached scratch so mode cannot determine purpose.

schedule.action: Write while fingers navigate; scroll and zoom with known transforms in each mode, retaining immutable original coordinates.
Reflow, change page/question and seek video; continue writing with new context segments where the material changes.
Retain known placement changes; mark unverified mappings unresolved and retain original anchors instead of relabeling Q1 ink as Q2.
Switch display mode while another device has a stale display head; preserve purpose and archive choices.
Replay the old mode update and ink events; restart and recover both originals, source contexts and display histories.
Plan separate normal-navigation/composed-input evidence per mode; compare an explicitly frozen fallback.

expected: Content-attached rendering follows only verified source transforms; screen-fixed rendering stays screen-relative without losing F1 provenance.
Mode switches do not change purpose, destination, raw ink or historical source; stale writes cannot replace the current display relation.
Question changes never silently reassign fixed or attached old ink; unresolved placement and frozen status are explicit.
Both modes require their own live device/composite evidence; one mode, owned canvas or A45 cannot pass both modes or A44.
No arbitrary video-object tracking or universal cross-app interaction capability is inferred.

preconditions: A mixed writing session contains note N, scratch S and uncertain segment U under either display mode; AI purpose assessment cites actual context.

schedule.action: Infer purposes by segment/revision, queue the note archive workflow and retain uncertainty for U without demanding per-stroke labels.
Correct N to scratch with recorded basis; later correct another scratch segment to note.
Append corrections, update purpose head and invalidate obsolete classifier/export jobs atomically.
Try dispatching N to Notability or replacing its corrected purpose from an old inference; restart.
Reverse dispatch/correction order so an external outcome is already shared/imported/unknown, then request retry.
Develop retained scratch into a final answer; keep its original attempts and invoke the completion-choice flow.

expected: Explicit correction beats stale inference; original bytes, layout, source, errors and historical assessments remain intact.
Only currently eligible learning notes enter the preferred archive workflow; scratch is preserved internally without automatic external sending.
Uncertainty prompts minimal clarification as needed, not forced per-stroke classification; AI automatic notes can stay in-app.
Stale queued export is fenced; if the external action won, preserve its actual outcome and reconcile unknown before retry rather than claiming recall.
Display mode does not select purpose or destination; a final answer remains eligible for the user's organization choice.
Purpose changes do not erase actual help or create independent-mastery evidence.

preconditions: Q1 has a screen answer with retained original revision and separately classified completion confidence; no organization refusal initially exists.

schedule.action: Compare short pause, correct-looking result, leaving the page, resumed edits and evidenced completion; none of the first three alone confirms completion.
Concurrently propose the same current on-screen organization prompt; claim one logical prompt and record scheduling separately from actual display.
For unknown completion show one brief combined completion/organization question without exposing a correct solution; record actual time or lost receipt as unknown.
Refuse organization, then restart, switch device/display/purpose and explicitly retry Q1.

Try replaying the old prompt, sending a delayed positive choice after edits/Q2 switch or resending because display ACK was lost. Separately deliver an authenticated explicit refusal from an already shown Q1/O1 prompt after O2 was written.
Explicitly request organization again; delay an older refusal until after this causally newer request and separately test unknown cross-device order. Also complete a genuinely different Q2.
Plan actual completion-to-display timing and failure evidence; do not infer timeliness from server enqueue time.

expected: Evidenced completion triggers timely concise choices; unknown prompts once and never fabricates completion from pause/correctness.
Refusal persists across same-question retries, restart and devices; new jobs or mode changes cannot reset it.
Old-version prompts/positive choices and uncertain disconnected display are suppressed; duplicate/missing receipt does not authorize repeated prompts.

A truthful delayed explicit refusal still suppresses repeated Q1 prompts after O2 edits, without suppressing Q2. A causally newer explicit reopening request can supersede it; an older refusal arriving last cannot overwrite that request. Unknown causal order remains restrictive/unknown, not wall-clock ordered.
An explicit new user request can reopen organization; Q2 has separate history and does not inherit a global refusal.
Scheduling/display/response/refusal are separate facts; database locking alone does not prove remote no-repeat behavior.
Organization clarification does not grant solution disclosure or cancel ordinary teaching/supervision/preparation globally.
Any timing threshold is an engineering default to measure, not a user-specified number or a measured result here.

preconditions: Saved authorized bCourses material identifies course/assignment/question/version for the pinned screen answer; actual destination capabilities are separately evidenced.

schedule.action: Offer actually available Notability archive, corresponding assignment PDF/document, preview and not-now paths at completion; unavailable paths are not promised.
Choose preview or defer, then later explicitly choose an available destination; reuse saved source rather than ask for the material again.
Introduce ambiguity in assignment/question/version; retain candidates and ask only the necessary short clarification.
Change original-answer version or revoke destination permission after menu creation but before a delayed click/dispatch.
Attempt processing that stale selection and a bCourses submission inferred only from source access.
Bind preparation/share/import/failed/unknown evidence to the chosen pinned original and actual available route.

expected: Choice is runtime-specific and independent of display/purpose; Notability preference does not hard-code all final-answer destinations.
Course/assignment/question/version are preserved; ambiguous association is not guessed and an updated source never silently replaces the pinned version.
Preview/defer writes nothing externally; choosing organization is not homework filling/submission authority.
Old menu clicks do not authorize a changed answer, unsupported capability or revoked destination.
Having opened a Notability document does not establish an internal write API; fallback is explicit, not an automatic substitution.
Selected target, prepared file and actual import remain different outcomes with honest limits.

preconditions: Pinned answer O1 includes actual derivation, mistakes, layout/source and earlier help history; original editable ink remains archived independently.

schedule.action: Prepare organized derivative D1 preserving O1; before showing identifiable AI suggestions and layout/content differences, check current attempt/request/help-policy and revocation. Test layout-only or withdrawn-help permission with an AI full-solution suggestion; withhold that suggestion across preview/title/diagram/audio while preserving authorized original-work organization.
Confirm intended content changes for exact D1, then edit the original to O2 while a stale D1 worker or regenerated D2 is pending.
Try treating the old preview approval as consent for changed bytes or a changed answer; also try stripping AI layers to relabel the work independent.
Prepare/share only the current appropriately approved pinned version through a supported path; lose the external result.
Retry; reconcile via supported target observation or labeled confirmation first, preserving unknown if no sufficient evidence exists.
Correct purpose or delete the local note during processing; test late import evidence and pending cancellation separately.

expected: O1/O2 raw answer, real derivation, mistakes, layout and source are not overwritten by D1/D2; original language is unchanged by teaching preferences.
AI changes are distinct and previewable; content changes require confirmation tied to exact output/original versions.

Organization/preview choice never raises help permission. AI suggestions must pass final disclosure checks before being shown; accepting content changes afterwards cannot repair premature solution disclosure.
Old confirmation cannot approve a different artifact; a historical explicitly pinned export remains historical rather than masquerading as the current answer.
Neither final-answer status, removed AI layers nor export success erases prior help or proves independent mastery.
Unknown external outcome is reconciled before resend; failed/unknown import keeps editable originals, and late evidence binds the exact artifact.
Local deletion fences pending work but cannot claim removal of an external copy without proof; no automatic replacement, duplicate or submission is authorized.
PDF/PNG does not become native editable target ink; import cannot fill an unverified live-screen A44 gap.

adr_continuation.oracle: Current ADR and applicable original requirements/confirmed intent; reported Web MODEL behavior is a defect input, not the expected-result oracle.
adr_continuation.composition: Each variant and each parameter choice starts from an independent fresh fixture with its family preconditions. Listed schedules are injected barriers, not evidence of cross-device causal order. Local AD identifiers are not new acceptance IDs or protocol fields.
historical_clarifications: C4-V25 no observed target display means no proven learner presentation/reading. Current ADR section 7 additionally requires possible external exposure for shared/imported or possibly effected help-bearing content, including when the local dispatch record is missing. The earlier packet is preserved, not used to assert no exposure.

Current ADR section 5 governs earlier open tombstone prose: minimal non-content fences may remain until every accepted stale replay/restore path is provably fenced; TTL alone is insufficient. No deleted text, revealing reason, answer hash or embedding may be retained to reconstruct erased content.

schedule_families.topic: T1 external effect evidence and possible exposure
preconditions: Synthetic retained Q1/A1, exact original O1 and help-bearing manifest X1 including L1; L2 is omitted. Preserve any earlier genuine L2 presentation separately.
A candidate external receipt has an authenticated permitted producer and independently checked owner, target, attempt, manifest and layer bindings. A reported state or enum alone is not evidence.
expected: Separate external effect, possible external exposure, proven learner presentation, actual reading and mastery. An effect receipt creates neither a missing local dispatch record nor retroactive consent.

New or corrected exposure evidence advances the evidence set and atomically invalidates dependent current judgments, including Q1/A2 with empty in-app receipts. Repeat both projection/evidence commit orders using C1-V06; identical receipt replay has no additional invalidation.
Only included evidenced layers contribute through X1; omitted L2 is not delivered by X1, while earlier genuine L2 exposure is retained. Novel unrelated Q2 is not automatically contaminated.

Apply current ADR section 5 deletion and replay fences: a late fact cannot restore erased payload or deleted work. Any permitted reconciliation metadata must be minimal and independently authorized, not a revived execution grant.

schedule.action: Independently seed each listed local history for X1; withhold or reorder the local dispatch event. No history establishes confirmed absence of an external effect.
Deliver valid evidence of the exact external effect; then deliver a delayed local dispatch fact where applicable, restart and replay the effect receipt.
Query A1 and a later same-question A2 with no in-app presentation receipts; query separately identified Q2 as a control.

expected: Accept the valid factual effect even without a local dispatch transition or after cancellation/failure. Record the discrepancy and unresolved order rather than dropping the fact or fabricating dispatch.
Record possible external exposure for X1/L1. Actual reading remains unknown; sharing alone is not import, and import alone is not reading. No-help assumptions for Q1 are invalidated once.

local_history: effect receipt delivered before local dispatch record
local pre-dispatch cancellation state without independent no-effect proof
local failure state without independent no-effect proof

schedule.action: Attempt an authorized X1 handoff that may have taken effect, then lose its outcome. Withhold the local dispatch log in a separate run.
Request retry while the outcome remains unknown; query all historical and current effect/exposure indicators.
Resolve independently to a verified effect or to sufficient confirmed no-effect evidence; replay the resolution after restart.

expected: Unknown outcome retains possible external exposure and its exact scope; it does not assert that X1 was definitely shared/imported or read. Inspect all history-derived flags, not only a latest status.

Reconcile before duplicate-risk retry. A supported resolution supersedes uncertainty with history intact; confirmed no effect removes only this attempt as a possible source and never erases other genuine exposure.

schedule.action: Run the listed controls independently; retain the evidence establishing which boundary was actually crossed.
Evaluate the proposed receipt and Q1 help history, then attempt stale authorization or deleted-content replay.

expected: Preparation or opening a share panel alone creates no external-exposure fact. Positively confirmed cancellation before any effect also creates none from that attempt; a local cancellation label alone is insufficient.

Reject invalid or mismatched evidence as proof; preserve any separate unresolved dispatch uncertainty. Reject stale execution authority and deleted-content revival without discarding independently valid retained historical facts.

control: cancellation with sufficient proof of no external effect
stale execution token or replay after scoped deletion

schedule_families.topic: Every included AI layer checked at external dispatch
preconditions: For answer-organization variants, pin O1, permitted preview P1, exact manifest X1 and applicable scoped confirmation. Classroom archival controls instead use their stated existing grant without a mandatory preview. Store original editable ink, source context and earlier help independently.
Inventory every included AI layer/segment and its reviewed content extent; labels such as correction or layout-only do not establish harmlessness.
expected: At external dispatch, recheck current choice, problem/source/original version, purpose, destination permission, cancellation/deletion/authorization and current content-specific disclosure assessment and permission for every included AI layer.
An earlier successful preview check or confirmation cannot authorize changed permission, hidden content or a stale manifest. Organization choice alone never widens the help request.
Preserve faithful user originals, derivation, mistakes, language and layout; no required AI filtering operation may overwrite stored originals or turn assisted work into independent mastery.

schedule.action: Approve P1/X1 while its exact included layers are permitted, then hold dispatch.
Independently change one listed authority/context fact after preview, leaving bytes unchanged where possible.
Evaluate each included layer at the final external-dispatch boundary, independently checking reviewed content against the actual bounded request.

expected: Block the stale or newly restricted effect before dispatch; unchanged bytes and old confirmation do not preserve permission.
Assertions examine exact target, allowed extent and all content/layers, not only request ID, an open flag, a model-provided label or the first AI layer.

changed_fact: help withdrawal or lower allowed extent
semantic reassessment from hint to solution
target permission, authorization, deletion or cancellation

schedule.action: Hide or remove an answer-bearing layer from P1 while leaving it in X1; independently test a layout-only choice with an AI corrected answer.
Compare the actual export layers with the permitted preview and scoped confirmation, then try to repair X1 by stripping or substituting content.
Review the changed permitted content under a new manifest and supply its applicable confirmation before any new dispatch.

expected: Block unrepresented or impermissible layers; asking for confirmation after disclosure does not repair it.
Any content change creates a new manifest and requires its applicable confirmation. The old approval cannot silently authorize a filtered or regenerated artifact.

schedule.action: Independently run restriction/cancellation before effect, and evidenced external effect before restriction/cancellation, using a deterministic boundary rather than just a DB claim time.
Report actual, partial or unknown outcomes and reconcile any unknown result before duplicate-risk retry.

expected: If withdrawal wins the dispatch fence, block the effect. If the effect already occurred, preserve its exact history and possible exposure; later withdrawal does not imply remote rollback.
A committed dispatch claim is not an external effect. An unresolved claim-to-effect race stays explicitly uncertain and cannot be counted as a successful cancellation.

schedule.action: Independently run a currently permitted exact AI-layer export represented in P1/confirmation, and faithful original-only classroom archival under its existing valid grant.
Verify current restrictions and dispatch only the pinned permitted content through the authorized path.

expected: Permit the bounded positive controls; no mandatory per-stroke confirmation is added to ordinary classroom archival.
An archival grant cannot override restricted problem help. A successful share is not automatically import, reading, editable Notability strokes, or A44/A46 acceptance.

schedule_families.topic: T3 connected presenter and unsynchronized restrictive intent
preconditions: A is the connected active presenter for Q1; B is a same-problem device able to accept intent. Uniqueness of presenter does not exclude B from intent/capture or infer B synchronization.
Pin server-known revision r5, exact content H, claim, bounded target and independently reviewed content extent. Track A/B/server knowledge separately.
expected: Retain server-known intent revision and synchronization knowledge at claim and final presentation. Unknown connectivity/order cannot establish global synchronization.

Known unsynced intent-capable devices prevent proactive disclosure escalation. A fresh explicit request is evaluated only within current known restrictions and its target; it cannot override an unordered conflicting refusal.

Independently assert request identity, target, allowed extent, reviewed content extent and actual displayed/played range. Apply boundaries to cards, titles, notifications, previews, diagrams, speech and AI-bearing export dispatch.

A local or server timestamp, larger revision, acknowledgement, socket reconnect or test step order alone is not causal supersession. Preparation and unrelated Q2/classroom teaching retain their own scope; organization refusal and help restriction remain distinct.

schedule.action: While connected, record restrictive D; hold transmission or acknowledgement, then reconnect. Independently run D as let-me-try and concept-only downgrade; repeat with A originating D.
Independently deliver stale r4, equal r5 and newer unrelated r6 snapshots, none acknowledging or causally superseding D.

Apply snapshots, restart and receive a later acknowledgement of D. Assert the originating device retains D directly. In B-origin runs, attempt output only on authorized presenter A after each relevant synchronization/intent update reaches A; in A-origin runs, attempt cached solution output on A at each boundary.

expected: The originating device retains D and its pending intent across every snapshot/restart, whether D originated connected or offline. Newer unrelated state cannot reopen disclosure.
Acknowledging D establishes synchronization of that fact, not permission to reopen. Other devices do not invent D before learning it, but known unsynced status constrains proactive escalation.

schedule.action: Hold D unsynchronized while A remains connected.
Independently publish B-unsynced knowledge before A claim issuance or after claim issuance but before final presentation.
Try proactive escalation from H/cache and separately a fresh bounded explicit request under known current restrictions.

expected: No proactive escalation in either ordering; an old claim does not bypass the final synchronization/permission check.
The explicit request is no proof of global order and cannot override an unordered conflicting refusal. Allowed content is assessed separately from merely accepting a request.

schedule.action: Record B retraction D without a causal link to A physical output. Independently deliver D before final output or after a reported H prefix; separately delay B-unsynced knowledge until after the prefix.
Stop withdrawn remaining content when D becomes known; delay/drop and later replay the prefix presentation receipt.
Reassess evidence and compliance using the actual knowledge/order limits, including the missing-receipt interval.

expected: When D is known before the final boundary, fence withdrawn content. Otherwise retain actual/partial/unknown exposure, stop remaining output and invalidate affected judgments.

Unknown D-to-presentation order remains unknown even if the harness invoked D first. Do not retroactively label it compliant or count it as zero disclosure; absent ACK does not prove silence. Late factual receipts authorize no replay.

schedule.action: Create D independently of A explicit request U; neither device observes the other event.

Run two fresh orders explicitly: deliver D, deliver U, then attempt output; or deliver U, attempt output/report any started prefix, then deliver D and stop remaining output. Use opposing wall clocks and a numerically newer unrelated snapshot carrying U.

At each output boundary independently check actual request/content extent and known restrictions; retain actual/partial/unknown output and process D evidence invalidation without rewriting the earlier knowledge state.

expected: Arrival/revision order cannot widen permission over unordered D. If U was accepted or output started before D became known, preserve that history and unresolved relation, constrain remaining output and invalidate judgments.
Neither overwrite history as compliant nor discard genuine output. Reconnecting must not clear the unresolved restriction.

schedule.action: Accept D and deliver its authoritative state to A; establish actual causal knowledge, not only delivery time.

Record a genuinely later explicit U based on that state for the exact target; accept it with no unresolved conflicting intent. Independently run concept-only U and explicitly requested full-solution U.
Replay old D/snapshots before and after U delivery. In a separate run establish U causally before D2, then deliver old U after D2.

expected: In the positive direction, old D cannot cancel genuinely later accepted U: permit only independently reviewed concept content for concept-only U, and separately permit the explicitly requested full-solution control.
In the reverse direction D2 remains effective; late old U cannot reopen. These controls reject both over-disclosure and permanent blocking of valid causal reopening.

schedule_families.topic: Linked legacy v1 note paths and edit/export commit orders
preconditions: Seed legacy note N/O1 with preserved editable user originals, source anchors and an AI layer L. Retain a prior PUT response and immutable revision, then create its server-owned restricted v2 association.

Current v1 code returns full note content for GET and fresh, cached and historical PUT success. Authenticated user principals may also carry AI blocks; actor role alone does not establish content authority.
expected: Resolve current server-owned association and authority before every response/cache/history shortcut. Linked legacy AI-layer writes are unsupported until a guarded adapter exists; CAS and original protection are insufficient.

Restricted legacy reads, including AI-bearing PUT responses, require explicit use-v2 behavior if the client cannot enforce permission. Provide a compatible safe original-only path or v2 original-only view; never overwrite/truncate stored revisions for redaction.

A legitimate user edit must retain CAS/history/ink and atomically invalidate linked derivations, claims, previews and confirmations, or fail explicitly with no partial mutation if the adapter cannot preserve those invariants.
Preserve immutable originals and history through rollback. No new v0.1.0 payload field, error shape or migration is defined here; the formal compatibility adapter remains lead-owned.

schedule.action: Independently attempt a fresh AI-layer write, exact cached PUT replay, exact persisted revision replay without that cache key, and valid-CAS original-only edit carrying unchanged AI layers. Repeat with user and assistant principals.
Check current association, mutation authority and returned-content permission before returning success. Also inject changed payload under a used key and stale CAS.
Restart and replay successful authorized facts through each path; compare note head, immutable originals and evidence generations.

expected: No actor or replay shortcut bypasses linked AI-write/read restrictions. A carried unchanged AI layer is still disclosure if returned, even when the original edit itself is legitimate.

Exact accepted historical replay returns only a currently permitted receipt/view, never moves head, repeats invalidation or restores old permission. Reusing an idempotency key with changed payload conflicts. A stale-CAS mutation that is not an exact already-persisted revision conflicts without partial effects. Exact historical replay remains subject to current association, authority and response-disclosure guards. If safe response semantics are unavailable, fail explicitly rather than quietly saving then exposing a solution.

schedule.action: After association or help withdrawal/downgrade, semantic reassessment, source revocation or association correction, request current and historical GET plus each prior AI-bearing PUT response.
Evaluate current resource and layer authority; try a caller-supplied capability label as a negative control.
Read retained permitted originals through the supported safe view, including after feature rollback. Separately check unchanged unassociated v1 behavior and a permitted v2-aware presentation.

expected: Old revision permission and caller-declared capability cannot authorize restricted AI content; explicit unsupported/use-v2 behavior must coexist with appropriately authorized original/ink access.
Original O1 bytes, ink and source links remain intact. Unassociated v1 behavior/bytes and currently permitted v2-aware access remain positive controls.

schedule.action: Using fresh fixtures, run association commit before queued legacy edit, and valid unassociated O2 edit commit before association. Repeat for corrected old/new problem scopes.
Under the existing actor transaction boundary check the actual current head/CAS and association, commit authorized edit or association plus all affected invalidations together.
Attempt a stale job based on an earlier empty association lookup and replay a cached pre-association PUT result.

expected: Association-first edit uses a guarded adapter or explicit rejection. Edit-first association includes actual O2 and invalidates affected old/new scopes, including dependencies on absence of association.

Stale jobs and responses cannot revive eligibility. Failed CAS cannot partly alter association, originals or invalidation state. Compare O1/O2 originals, source context, ink references and immutable history.

schedule.action: Pin O1/P1/X1 and scoped confirmation. Independently run O2 edit commit before final dispatch; actual X1 effect before O2 edit; and dispatch claim commit then O2 edit then delayed effect/receipt.
Apply AD2 current dispatch checks and edit invalidation; retain independently evidenced outcomes through AD1 instead of inferring an effect from the claim.
Request retry or a fresh explicit historical O1 export after O2. Reconcile unknown outcomes and distinguish a newly authorized historical choice from stale confirmation reuse.

expected: Edit-first fences stale X1; regenerated content needs a new manifest and applicable confirmation. Effect-first preserves exact historical X1 and possible exposure without renaming it O2 or claiming recall.

Claim-first is not effect-first: a future dispatcher must fence stale claims, and any remaining physical race uncertainty stays explicit. A delayed valid effect is not discarded to simulate a successful fence.
A fresh explicit historical-version choice still passes all current authority, disclosure and applicable confirmation rules; old current-answer approval alone cannot bypass edit invalidation.
